title: Walton Math Fest
text:
Walton MathFest is a middle school level math competition offered at Walton High School in Marietta, GA. Typically held in the fall, it is one of the largest math middle school math competitions in its area, serving the East Cobb region, Cobb County as a whole, and greater Metro Atlanta. In the 2026-27 school year, it is held on August 29, 2026.

Competition Structure[edit]

The competition consists of a Written round, Ciphering round, Team round, and Estimation round.

Individual scores are determined by the Written and Ciphering rounds. The Written round is made up of 25 multiple choice questions to be taken in 1 hour. The Ciphering round is made up of 10 short answer questions, each to be taken in 2 minutes. All questions are worth 1 point with no penalty for guessing, with ciphering score and specific questions used as tiebreakers.

Teams are made up of 4 students, and their scores are determined by the sum of the individuals' scores in addition to the Team round. The Team round has 10 short answer questions to be taken in 30 minutes.

The Estimation round is not graded and serves as a fun activity to pass the time while organizers score. Questions are usually trivia based such as global statistics or fun facts about the Cobb County area.

Previous Formats[edit]

Walton MathFest, prior to the pandemic, had many formats and levels, including an elementary school level, and JV/Varsity high school levels.
